","/**
 * Detects device information including browser, OS, and device type
 * @returns {Object} - { browser, os, type }

const getDeviceInfo = () => {
 const ua = navigator.userAgent;

 // Detect Browser
 let browser = 'Unknown';
 if (ua.includes('Edg/')) {
 browser = 'Microsoft Edge';
 } else if (ua.includes('Chrome/') && !ua.includes('Edg/') && !ua.includes('OPR/')) {
 browser = 'Google Chrome';
 } else if (ua.includes('Safari/') && !ua.includes('Chrome/')) {
 browser = 'Safari';
 } else if (ua.includes('Firefox/')) {
 browser = 'Firefox';
 } else if (ua.includes('Opera/') || ua.includes('OPR/')) {
 browser = 'Opera';
 } else if (ua.includes('Trident/') || ua.includes('MSIE ')) {
 browser = 'Internet Explorer';
 }

 // Detect OS
 let os = 'Unknown';

 if (ua.includes('iPhone') || ua.includes('iPad') || ua.includes('iPod')) {
 os = 'iOS';
 } else if (ua.includes('Win')) {
 os = 'Windows';
 } else if (ua.includes('Mac')) {
 os = 'macOS';
 } else if (ua.includes('CrOS')) {
 os = 'Chrome OS';
 } else if (ua.includes('Android')) {
 os = 'Android';
 } else if (ua.includes('X11') || ua.includes('Linux')) {
 os = 'Linux';
 }

 // Detect Device Type
 let type = 'desktop';
 if (/Mobi|Android|iPhone|iPad|iPod/i.test(ua)) {
 // Further differentiate between mobile and tablet
 if (/iPad|Android(?!.*Mobile)/i.test(ua)) {
 type = 'tablet';
 } else {
 type = 'mobile';
 }
 }

 return {
 browser,
 os,
 type
 };
};

function getToken(): string {
 // Try multiple sources for the CSRF token
 return (window as any).g_ck
 || document.querySelector('meta[name="X-UserToken"]')?.getAttribute('content')
 || "";
}

function submitBorrowRequest(equipmentId: string, dueDate: string, currentUserId: string): { success: boolean; loanId?: string; error?: string } {
 const token = getToken();

 // Step 1: Look up member record using the pre-fetched user sys_id
 const memberXhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
 const memberQuery = encodeURIComponent("user=" + currentUserId);
 memberXhr.open(
 "GET",
 "/api/now/table/x_828868_tool_le_0_members?sysparm_query=" + memberQuery + "&sysparm_limit=1&sysparm_fields=sys_id",
 false
 );
 memberXhr.setRequestHeader("Accept", "application/json");
 if (token) memberXhr.setRequestHeader("X-UserToken", token);
 memberXhr.send();

 if (memberXhr.status !== 200) {
 return { success: false, error: "Error looking up your member record (HTTP " + memberXhr.status + ")." };
 }

 const memberResult = JSON.parse(memberXhr.responseText);
 if (!memberResult.result || memberResult.result.length === 0) {
 return { success: false, error: "You are not registered as a library member." };
 }

 const memberId = memberResult.result[0].sys_id;

 // Step 2: Create loan record
 const loanXhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
 loanXhr.open("POST", "/api/now/table/x_828868_tool_le_0_loan_rec", false);
 loanXhr.setRequestHeader("Content-Type", "application/json");
 loanXhr.setRequestHeader("Accept", "application/json");
 if (token) loanXhr.setRequestHeader("X-UserToken", token);
 loanXhr.send(JSON.stringify({
 equipment: equipmentId,
 member: memberId,
 status: "pending_approval",
 due_date: dueDate,
 }));

 if (loanXhr.status === 201) {
 const loanResult = JSON.parse(loanXhr.responseText);
 return { success: true, loanId: loanResult.result.sys_id };
 }
 return { success: false, error: "Error creating borrow request (HTTP " + loanXhr.status + "). Please try again." };
}

 if (token) xhr.setRequestHeader("X-UserToken", token);
 xhr.send();
 if (xhr.status === 200) {

 setCurrentUserId(result.result[0].sys_id);
 }
 }
